svg.aria-label: Which part was responsible? It said it rolled a 7 on a six-sided die: the LLM wrote it, and no tool ran. A new session forgot that you work in square metres: context, because it wasn't in CLAUDE.md. It re-rolled until it got a name it liked: the skill, because no rule said roll once. The skill said roll once, but it rolled twice: the LLM, because a rule is read, not a lock. It stopped after one roll and called it good: you, because nobody said what good means. The add tool refused to add 1,5 and 2: the tool, working as it should, because a tool can say no
